confirmed: The #361 propagated future-stamp observation was not reproduced in #362; the independent probe measured -6 to +6 ms source age and no sample earlier than the unchanged -20 ms future tolerance.

All 12,988 captured wait sequence values were contiguous, and every selected trace analyzer exited successfully.
